title: SDF Raymarching Playground
summary: Sphere-traced signed distance fields with smooth blending and soft shadows. Drag to orbit and switch between shaded, depth, normal and step-count views.

title: WebGPU Compute Particles
summary: Up to a quarter of a million particles simulated in a WGSL compute shader and drawn as instanced additive quads. Move the pointer to steer the attractor.
